title: The Flight Across the Restless Sea
intro: Picture standing on the deck of an overloaded vessel as the waves surge and the crew casts lots to lighten the load. A lone figure steps forward, accepting a fate that seems like the end, only for the depths to become a place of prayer and return. Behind lies a community warned of coming punishment, ahead lies an unexpected mercy.
clues: I was sent as a messenger to more than a hundred thousand people.
I left my people in anger before receiving permission to leave.
I boarded a laden ship and the crew cast lots to decide who would be thrown overboard.
I was cast into the sea and swallowed by a great fish while I was blameworthy.
I glorified Allah in the darknesses, declaring there is no deity but Him and that I had been of the wrongdoers.
I was cast onto the open shore, sick, and Allah caused a gourd plant to grow over me, then my people believed and were granted enjoyment for a time.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Prophet Musa
Prophet Hud
Prophet Nuh
Prophet Lut
Prophet Yunus

trial.label: What Trial Did I Face?
options: Thrown into a fire made cool and safe
Swallowed by the great fish after fleeing
Cast into a deep well by jealous brothers
Struck with long illness and loss of health
Commanded to sacrifice a beloved child
trial.answer: Swallowed by the great fish after fleeing

location.label: What Is My Key Element?
options: The wooden Ark on the flood waters
The cave of refuge from persecution
The sacred valley of Tuwa
The great fish and its belly
The cool fire prepared by idolaters
location.answer: The great fish and its belly

outcome.label: What Was My Outcome?
options: Saved by glorification and my people believed and were spared for a time
My people were turned into apes for breaking the Sabbath
My people were swallowed by the earth for arrogance
My people were seized by a mighty blast from the sky
My people were drowned by the great flood
outcome.answer: Saved by glorification and my people believed and were spared for a time

arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
verse: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more. (37:147)
